title: Support Center
subtitle: How can we help you today? Find quick answers to common questions or reach out directly to our support team.

contact.title: Contact
contact.responseTime: We usually respond within 24 to 48 business hours.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Your privacy matters to us. Review our terms and policies to understand how we protect and manage your data.

login.title: I cannot log in
login.description: Check that your email and password are correct. If the issue persists, reset your password using the link on the login page.

appIssue.title: The application is not working properly
appIssue.description: Make sure you have a stable internet connection and are using an updated supported web browser.

reportBug.title: How do I report a bug?
reportBug.description: Click on 'Contact support' providing a detailed description of the bug along with your system information.

deviceInfo.title: Device information
deviceInfo.description: Note down your operating system and the web browser you are currently using.

appInfo.title: Application information
appInfo.description: Identify the specific module or section of the platform where the issue occurs.

describeProblem.title: Describe the problem
describeProblem.description: Write down the exact steps required to reproduce the unexpected behavior.

screenshots.title: Screenshots
screenshots.description: Capture clear screenshots of error messages or unexpected screens to attach to your inquiry.
